test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.**

Neither teachers or the principal revolted against the new education policy.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Neither teachers or**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct phrase is '**Neither teachers nor**' instead of '**Neither teachers or**'.
 
• "Neither...nor" is a correlative conjunction used to connect two or more words or phrases that are related in a negative sense.
 
• It is used to indicate that none of the connected items or actions are true or applicable. 
 
• The conjunction "**neither...nor**" should be followed by two elements that agree in number.
 
• The sentence should be corrected to "*Neither teachers nor the principal revolted against the new education policy*." 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.
